cases.question: What do conditionally selected applicants to the Biomedical Engineering Technology program have to complete before full acceptance?
cases.standalone_question: What do conditionally selected applicants to the Biomedical Engineering Technology program have to complete before full acceptance?
cases.answer_excerpt:
Conditionally selected applicants to the Biomedical Engineering Technology program must complete several specific requirements before receiving full acceptance, including safety clearances, health documentation, and an orientation session.

* **Criminal Record Check:** Required as part of the British Columbia Criminal Records Review Act for students engaging with vulnerable adults or children during a practicum.
* **Immunization Review:** A mandatory health science student requirement submitted to Student Health Services, along with compliance with flu season immunization or masking policies for clinical settings.
* **Mandatory BMET Program Admission Forum:** Attendance at one of these forums before September to learn about the curriculum, tour labs, meet faculty and students, and explore career paths.
* **Face Respirator Fit Testing:** Completion of an N95 respirator fit test before entering the clinical practicum, with the original certificate carried at all times (and annual re-fitting required).

Sources:
- https://www.bcit.ca/programs/biomedical-engineering-technology-diploma-full-time-5063dipma/

cases.question: What minimum average does an ECET diploma graduate need to enter the Electrical Engineering degree at BCIT?
cases.standalone_question: What minimum average does an ECET diploma graduate need to enter the Electrical Engineering degree at BCIT?
cases.answer_excerpt:
To enter the Electrical Engineering degree (BEng) at BCIT as an ECET diploma graduate, applicants generally need a minimum average of 70%.

* **Direct ECET Diploma Graduates:** Graduates from an ECET diploma (any option) require a minimum average of 70% to meet the Step 1 entrance requirements.
* **Competitive Process:** Meeting the minimum 70% average allows you to apply, but entry to the degree is competitive based on GPA, and the highest GPAs each year are accepted. 
* **Alternative BCIT Diplomas:** The 70% minimum average also applies to graduates of the Mechatronics and Robotics diploma or the Biomedical Engineering Technology diploma (the latter requires an additional pre-approved physics course). 
* **Current ECET Students:** Current ECET students completing the common first year face a more competitive process; successful applicants admitted previously had an average GPA above 82% for diploma applicants and above 85% for common first year students.

Sources:
- https://www.bcit.ca/programs/electrical-engineering-bachelor-of-engineering-full-time-8030beng/

cases.question: money back if i withdraw after classes start?
cases.standalone_question: What is the BCIT refund policy or money back eligibility if I withdraw from a course or program after classes start?
cases.answer_excerpt:
Yes, you may still be eligible for a tuition refund if you withdraw after classes start, provided you do so by the specific refund deadline for your program or course type. 

* **Full-time programs:** For most full-time programs, the latest acceptable withdrawal date to receive a refund is 10 business days after the start of classes. Commitment fees are non-refundable and will be deducted from your refund according to your program type.
* **Flexible Learning (Part-time) courses:** Refund eligibility depends on the course length and format. For example, for classroom-based or synchronous courses longer than four weeks, the deadline to receive an 85% refund is prior to the second class. For asynchronous online courses longer than four weeks, the deadline is within two weeks of the course start date. 
* **Apprenticeship programs:** Refunds are available up to certain days prior to the start of class, but no refund is issued for withdrawals made nine days or less before classes start.

Sources:
- https://www.bcit.ca/admission/tuition-fees/refunds-withdrawals/
sub_queries: BCIT refund policy for course or program withdrawal after classes start

cases.question: BCIT 간호 프로그램 입학하려면 뭐가 필요해?
cases.standalone_question: What are the admission requirements for the Nursing program at BCIT?
cases.answer_excerpt:
BCIT의 간호(Bachelor of Science in Nursing) 프로그램에 입학하기 위해서는 경쟁 입학 절차에 따라 입학 요건을 충족해야 합니다. 

입학 요건 및 절차의 주요 내용은 다음과 같습니다:

- **영어 능력:** Category 2에 해당하는 영어(English Studies 12 67% 이상 또는 동등한 수준)가 필요합니다.
- **수학:** Pre-Calculus 11 (73%), Pre-Calculus 12 (67%), Foundations of Math 11 (73%), Foundations of Math 12 (73%), 기타 허용되는 BC/Yukon 과정 또는 MATH 0007 (73%) 중 하나를 충족해야 합니다.
- **화학:** Chemistry 11 (73% 이상)이 필요합니다.
- **학술 기초(Academic Foundations):** 다음 과목들을 최소 67% 이상의 성적으로 총 18.0 학점 이상 이수해야 합니다. (모든 학술 기초 과정은 지원 전에 완료되어야 합니다.)
  - ENGL 1177 (Academic Writing) 또는 동등한 과목 (3.0 학점)
  - BHSC 1200 (Human Anatomy and Physiology) 또는 동등한 과목으로 최근 3년 이내 이수 (6.0 학점)
  - PSYC 1101 (Introductory Psychology 1) 또는 동등한 과목 (3.0 학점)
  - 최소 100 레벨 이상의 서로 다른 두 학문 분야의 일반 교양(General Education) 선택 과목 (6.0 학점)
- **지원서 양식:** 온라인 지원 시 'Mandatory Applicant Questionnaire' 양식을 작성하여 제출해야 합니다.
- **조건부 합격 후 요건:** 조건부 합격을 한 후에는 범죄 경력 조회(Criminal Record Check)와 예방접종 기록(Immunization Records) 등의 추가 요구사항을 제출해야 합니다.

cases.question: Is the BCIT commitment fee refundable, what is deducted from a domestic technology student's refund, and what is the withdrawal deadline to get a refund?

* **Withdrawal Deadlines for Refunds:** 
  * **Full-time programs:** The latest acceptable withdrawal date to receive a refund is generally 10 business days after the start of class.
  * **Flexible Learning courses:** Deadlines vary by course format and length (for example, courses over four weeks with classroom or synchronous learning allow a refund if withdrawn prior to the second class, while asynchronous distance courses of more than four weeks allow a refund within two weeks of the course start date).
